name: nodepilot-desktop
description: NodePilot desktop shell — a thin Electron viewer for the locally-hosted NodePilot backend.
//engines: One repository-wide floor, not this project's own minimum. react-router 8 in
nodepilot-ui and nodepilot-docs-ui requires >=22.22.0; contributors build all three
from a single Node install, so publishing two different floors would just re-create
the version drift this field exists to remove.
//types-node: Electron 43.4.1 bundles Node 24.18.1. @types/node may be newer for tooling, so
runtime-only APIs must still be checked against the embedded Node release.
//archive-security: Packager 18 used extract-zip 2.0.1, which has no patched release
(CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv). Packager 20.3.0 uses Electron's hardened native
@electron-internal/extract-zip instead. Both are pinned exactly and exercised by security tests.
